title: A Sparse-Group Pliable Lasso
summary: The sparse-group pliable Lasso (SGPL) extends the pliable Lasso and group pliable Lasso by combining sparse-group regularization with a predictor-level coupling penalty, enabling simultaneous group-level selection, within-group sparsity, and hierarchical structure between main effects and interactions. We propose a blockwise coordinate descent algorithm for fitting the SGPL that exploits the convexity and structure of the objective function, establish convexity and Karush--Kuhn--Tucker optimality conditions, and prove that the algorithm converges to a global minimizer.
